locations: Supplementary eligibility criteria and Table S3
primarySources.population: 85 evaluable apparently healthy normo-ovulatory women, EU 18-37/US 22-37 years, one natural 24-35 day cycle; 82.4% white/Caucasian. Hormonal contraception, pregnancy and lactation excluded.
primarySources.method: Roche Elecsys Estradiol III, cobas e801
primarySources.supports: Interpretation depends on cycle phase/subphase and method.
primarySources.limits: Does not verify Tietz RI or define pregnancy, menopause or other assay references. No new numerical data imported.

legacyNumericalProvenance.edition: Tietz Textbook of Clinical Chemistry and Molecular Diagnostics,6th edition, 2018
legacyNumericalProvenance.verificationStatus: Relevant complete source table unavailable in this review; existing values retained without renewed numerical validation.
legacyNumericalProvenance.endpointLimitation: Legacy postmenopausal prose<110 pmol/L differs from numeric 0-110 row and inclusive known-context evaluation. Qualification fix does not revise that endpoint. Zero is not evidence for a lower RI, LOD or LOQ.

qualificationPolicy.scope: Existing adult female application routing; no invented source-specific age threshold.
qualificationPolicy.unknown: Four separate labeled references; no per-variant or overall verdict, no merged envelope.
qualificationPolicy.known: Existing follicular, ovulation, luteal or postmenopausal row; no age-based inference.
qualificationPolicy.adultTanner: Retained Tanner 1-5 cannot replace adult reproductive context; known phase takes priority. Pediatric rows unchanged.
qualificationPolicy.unsupported: Known pregnancy_t1, pregnancy_t2, pregnancy_t3 or other unsupported nonempty context gives no applicable RI; not ordinary-cycle alternatives.
qualificationPolicy.syntheticRegression: F, 30 years, E2=50 pmol/L, unknown context: measurement and conversion available; four alternatives, no classification; formerly follicular 70-290/below.
qualificationPolicy.history: New unknown-context snapshot uses existing v1/unavailable with retained measurement/context and no single applied classification. Old saved assessment is replayed, not recalculated. No lab.norm or schema addition.

clinicalImpact: Removes an unsupported follicular assumption. Owner authorized implementation after explicit proposal; technical tests do not confer clinical validation and owner retains clinical review/merge decision.
